#
font commands, font declarations, and font sizes
.
\textrm{roman}, \textsf{sans serif}, \texttt{typewriter}, \textmd{medium}, \textbf{bold},
\textup{upright}, \textit{italic}, \textsl{slanted}, \textsc{Small Caps}, \textnormal{normal}

\texttt{\textup{upright}, \textsl{slanted}, \textsc{Small Caps}},
\textsf{\textup{upright}, \textsl{slanted}, \textsc{Small Caps}},
\textsl{slanted \textrm{roman}, \texttt{typewriter}, \textit{italic}}

default \rmfamily roman \sffamily sans serif \ttfamily typewriter
\bfseries bold \mdseries medium
\itshape italic \slshape slanted \scshape Small Caps \upshape upright
\normalfont normal

\tiny tiny \scriptsize scriptsize \footnotesize footnotesize \small small \normalsize normalsize
\large large \Large Large \LARGE LARGE \huge huge \Huge Huge
.
<div class="body">
<p>
<span class="rm">roman</span>,
 <span class="sf">sans serif</span>,
 <span class="tt">typewriter</span>,
 <span class="md">medium</span>,
 <span class="bf">bold</span>,
 <span class="up">upright</span>,
 <span class="it">italic</span>,
 <span class="sl">slanted</span>,
 <span class="sc">Small Caps</span>,
 <span class="rm md up">normal</span>
</p>
<p>
<span class="tt"><span class="up">upright</span>, <span class="sl">slanted</span>, <span class="sc">Small Caps</span></span>,
 <span class="sf"><span class="up">upright</span>, <span class="sl">slanted</span>, <span class="sc">Small Caps</span></span>,
 <span class="sl">slanted <span class="rm">roman</span>, <span class="tt">typewriter</span>, <span class="it">italic</span></span>
</p>
<p>default <span class="rm">roman </span>
<span class="sf">sans serif </span>
<span class="tt">typewriter </span>
<span class="tt bf">bold </span>
<span class="tt md">medium </span>
<span class="tt md it">italic </span>
<span class="tt md sl">slanted </span>
<span class="tt md sc">Small Caps </span>
<span class="tt md up">upright </span>
<span class="rm md up">normal</span>
</p>
<p class="Huge">
<span class="rm md up tiny">tiny </span>
<span class="rm md up scriptsize">scriptsize </span>
<span class="rm md up footnotesize">footnotesize </span>
<span class="rm md up small">small </span>
<span class="rm md up normalsize">normalsize </span>
<span class="rm md up large">large </span>
<span class="rm md up Large">Large </span>
<span class="rm md up LARGE">LARGE </span>
<span class="rm md up huge">huge </span>
<span class="rm md up Huge">Huge</span>
</p>
</div>
.


\em and \emph{}
.
\em You can also \emph{emphasize} text.
.
<div class="body">
<p>
<span class="it">You can also </span>
<span class="it"><span class="up">emphasize</span></span>
<span class="it"> text.</span>
</p>
</div>
.


#
\emph{} command and nesting
.
Hello, \emph{this} is emphasized.

\emph{emph \textup{normal}}, \textup{normal \emph{emph}}

\emph{emph \emph{normal}}

test {test \em\em\em test \em test}

\textit{You can also \emph{emphasize} text if it is set in italics}
.
<div class="body">
<p>Hello, <span class="it">this</span> is emphasized.</p>
<p><span class="it">emph <span class="up">normal</span></span>, <span class="up">normal <span class="it">emph</span></span></p>
<p><span class="it">emph <span class="up">normal</span></span></p>
<p>test test <span class="it">test </span><span class="up">test</span></p>
<p><span class="it">You can also <span class="up">emphasize</span> text if it is set in italics</span></p>
</div>
.


fonts stay until the surrounding group ends      TODO: same spans should be merged
.
outer { text \bfseries {what} more text } end outer
.
<div class="body">
<p>outer ​ text <span class="bf">what</span><span class="bf">​ </span><span class="bf">more text </span>​ end outer</p>
</div>
.


fonts reach across paragraphs if no group ends
.
hello, \itshape what

are we going to do here?

\slshape
Wrap all the paragraphs.
.
<div class="body">
<p>hello, <span class="it">what</span></p>
<p><span class="it">are we going to do here?</span></p>
<p><span class="sl">Wrap all the paragraphs.</span></p>
</div>
.


fonts reach into environments
.
outer {\bfseries bold
\begin{center}
    still bold
\end{center}
bold} end outer
.
<div class="body">
<p>outer <span class="bf">bold</span></p>
<div class="list center">
<p><span class="bf">still bold</span></p>
</div>
<p class="continue"><span class="bf">bold</span>​ end outer</p>
</div>
.


font commands wrap inline content and environments in their argument separately
.
Some \textbf{bold \emph{italic} text \begin{itemize}\item bold item\end{itemize} more bold text} and normal text.
.
<div class="body">
<p class="continue">Some <span class="bf">bold <span class="it">italic</span> text</span>
<div class="bf">
<ul class="list">
<li><span class="itemlabel"><span class="hbox llap">•</span></span><p>bold item</p></li>
</ul>
</div>
<span class="bf"> more bold text</span> and normal text.
</p>
</div>
.


fonts reach into lists, and groups in items still end
.
\itshape italic
\begin{itemize}
    \item still italic
    \item {\upshape upright} and italic again
\end{itemize}
italic
.
<div class="body">
<p><span class="it">italic</span></p>
<ul class="list">
<li><span class="itemlabel"><span class="hbox llap">•</span></span><p><span class="it">still italic</span></p></li>
<li><span class="itemlabel"><span class="hbox llap">•</span></span><p><span class="up">upright</span><span class="it">​ </span><span class="it">and italic again</span></p></li>
</ul>
<p class="continue"><span class="it">italic</span></p>
</div>
.


fonts set in an environment combine with the outer fonts, and end with the environment
.
\small small
\begin{quote}
    \bfseries small and bold
\end{quote}
only small
.
<div class="body">
<p class="small"><span class="small">small</span></p>
<div class="list quote">
<p class="small"><span class="bf small">small and bold</span></p>
</div>
<p class="small continue"><span class="small">only small</span></p>
</div>
.


a paragraph continued after an environment may start with a font change
.
text
\begin{center}
    centered
\end{center}
\textbf{bold} start of the continued paragraph

\textbf{bold} start of a new paragraph
.
<div class="body">
<p>text</p>
<div class="list center">
<p>centered</p>
</div>
<p class="continue"><span class="bf">bold</span> start of the continued paragraph</p>
<p><span class="bf">bold</span> start of a new paragraph</p>
</div>
.


monospaced fonts do not use ligatures
.
\texttt{first test of -- and ---}
.
<div class="body">
<p><span class="tt">first test of -- and ---</span></p>
</div>
.


#
a paragraph has the line spacing of the font size at its end
.
The spacing of these lines is larger because the paragraph ends with a larger font size. The text before it
keeps its size: \textbf{bold text}, \verb|verbatim|, $e^x$, and {\tiny a group}. \LARGE The end.

\normalsize
The spacing of these lines is normal because the font size is only changed in a group.
{\tiny This is tiny text, and the group ends before the paragraph.}

\footnotesize
\begin{itemize}
    \item The label and the line spacing of the first paragraph of an item have the font size of the item, too, and
        so do \verb|verbatim| and $x$.
    \item[$\ast$] custom label
\end{itemize}
\begin{description}
    \item[term] description
\end{description}
.
<div class="body">
<p class="LARGE">
<span class="normalsize">The spacing of these lines is larger because the paragraph ends with a larger font size. The text before it keeps its size: <span class="bf">bold text</span>, <code class="tt">verbatim</code>, <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>e</mi><mi>x</mi></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">e^x</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="katex-base"><span class="katex-strut" style="height: 0.6644em;"></span><span class="mord"><span class="mord mathnormal">e</span><span class="msupsub"><span class="vlist-t"><span class="vlist-r"><span class="vlist" style="height: 0.6644em;"><span class="" style="top: -3.063em; margin-right: 0.05em;"><span class="pstrut" style="height: 2.7em;"></span><span class="katex-sizing reset-size6 size3 mtight"><span class="mord mathnormal mtight">x</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span>, and </span>
<span class="tiny">a group</span>
<span class="normalsize">. </span>
<span class="LARGE">The end.</span>
</p>
<p class="normalsize">
<span class="normalsize">The spacing of these lines is normal because the font size is only changed in a group. </span>
<span class="tiny">This is tiny text, and the group ends before the paragraph.</span>
</p>
<ul class="list">
<li><span class="itemlabel footnotesize"><span class="hbox llap">•</span></span>
<p class="footnotesize">
<span class="footnotesize">The label and the line spacing of the ﬁrst paragraph of an item have the font size of the item, too, and so do </span>
<code class="tt footnotesize">verbatim</code>
<span class="footnotesize"> and </span>
<span class="footnotesize"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="katex-base"><span class="katex-strut" style="height: 0.4306em;"></span><span class="mord mathnormal">x</span></span></span></span></span>
<span class="footnotesize">.</span>
</p>
</li>
<li><span class="itemlabel footnotesize"><span class="hbox llap"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>∗</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\ast</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="katex-base"><span class="katex-strut" style="height: 0.4653em;"></span><span class="mord">∗</span></span></span></span></span></span>
<p class="footnotesize">
<span class="footnotesize">custom label</span>
</p>
</li>
</ul>
<dl class="list">
<dt class="footnotesize">term</dt>
<dd>
<p class="footnotesize">
<span class="footnotesize">description</span>
</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</div>
.


text without a size keeps its size if the paragraph ends in a group with another size
.
Text without a size, \large large text, and {\small small text in a group.\par}
.
<div class="body">
<p class="small">
<span class="normalsize">Text without a size, </span>
<span class="large">large text, and </span>
<span class="small">small text in a group.</span>
</p>
</div>
.


#
em lengths are relative to font size at the end of the paragraph
.
\small
a line of text\\[1em]
a line of text\\[1em]
\Huge   % this changes ALL line spacing (\baselineskip) of the current paragraph, also above!
a line of text\\[1em]
a line of text

\small
a line of text\\[1em]
a line of text

\Huge
a line of text\\[1em]
a line of text
.
<div class="body">
<p class="Huge">
<span class="small">a line of text</span><span class="small"><span class="breakspace" style="margin-bottom:1em"></span></span>
<span class="small">a line of text</span><span class="small"><span class="breakspace" style="margin-bottom:1em"></span></span>
<span class="Huge">a line of text</span><span class="Huge"><span class="breakspace" style="margin-bottom:1em"></span></span>
<span class="Huge">a line of text</span>
</p>
<p class="small">
<span class="small">a line of text</span><span class="small"><span class="breakspace" style="margin-bottom:1em"></span></span>
<span class="small">a line of text</span>
</p>
<p class="Huge">
<span class="Huge">a line of text</span><span class="Huge"><span class="breakspace" style="margin-bottom:1em"></span></span>
<span class="Huge">a line of text</span>
</p>
</div>
.
